about.text: b. April 3, 2006 d. June 18, 2011 (zombie resurrection October 4, 2013)

They were a band that mattered to many. In true DIY-spirit they produced their own recordings and travelled many a road to perform their punk pop wonders to whoever was willing to lend them an ear. With a bit of help from friends around Europe they planned and played shows in cities like Hamburg, Berlin, Cologne, Gent, Greifswald, Rostock, Dresden, Chemnitz, Frankfurt, Freiburg and more. Plenty of good old times!

"The Upallnights are the kind of band Sweden has never before been able to produce; the sort of band you have seen emerge from the streets of New York, Detroit or Manchester - but not Stockholm. Until now, that is. They are one of those bands that materialize out of the industrialized suburbs' old concrete air-raid shelters, out of pure joy and love for the music. As the old shelter gives birth to frustration, frustration gave birth to a band that plays, what can only be described as, groundbreaking punk pop with a beat you can dance to and melodies you cannot help but sing along with.

Perhaps it is the fact that they play with their hearts exposed that has made their songs so popular. Fronting the band are the two brothers Anders Wallner and Kristoffer Sundberg along with Taivas Mikkola. By sharing lead vocals between the three of them, they generate an interesting tension that gives their songs an extra dimension; a bit like a Swedish version of the Gallaghers, but with extra cheese. And more punk rock of course. And an actual drummer in Erik Dahlström. With the looks of the Strokes, and a sound resembling a clash of Sonic Youth, The Libertines, Pavement and The Beatles, they strive to remind everyone of what many seem to have forgotten; music is supposed to be all about honesty, joy and love. And - if your heart should happen to be broken, you can still dance."

manifesto: What you do first is the right thing, and just move on
We are only in it for the fun of it
If someone is willing to give us money, a recording contract, or extend an invitation to us to have dinner in their home, we will not decline
We believe strongly that China should get out of Tibet
We believe strongly that Stephen Malkmus and Jesus Christ are the same person
We reserve the right to change our minds at any time

We believe strongly that all internet communities, Myspace, Facebook etc, are run by the CIA to keep people distracted so that the American Government can go about their business without beeing disturbed. Therefore, all communities must be destroyed. This is best done from the inside and that's the real reason for us making music and posting it on the web, forget about all that talk about "fun" in §2.
This Manifesto will grow as we think of more things to put in it (Feel free to make suggestions, we'll consider anything)
